# Synthetic side-scan sonar campaign: 56 XTF files

**SYNTHETIC DATA.** Generated by `ai/tools/generate_xtf.py` (simulator in `ai/tools/sonar_sim/`). It is a physically based
simulation, not real survey recordings, but the XTF files are standard. Every file says so in its header note.

## Areas (7 × 8 lawnmower lines)
| Code | Area | Depth | Sonar (simulated class) | Seabed | Targets |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CHN | Chennai Port approaches | 15–22 m | towed dual-freq 400/900 kHz, 75/40 m | sand + mud, sand waves, trawl marks | 2 wrecks (1 broken), containers, tyre dumps, debris, anchor + chain, 1 human body, fish |
| VIZ | Visakhapatnam exercise area | 38–46 m | towed dual-freq 100/500 kHz, 100/50 m | sand/gravel, sand waves | 8 cylinder + 4 manta mine-like objects, ordnance, pipeline, 72 m wreck |
| KOC | Kochi fishing grounds | 13–18 m | towed 600 kHz, 50 m | mud, trawl marks, pockmarks | ghost nets (2 draped on rock), 3 crab-pot strings, tyres, boat wreck, fish schools |
| MUM | Mumbai High pipeline corridor | 66–72 m | towed dual-freq 100/500 kHz, 100/50 m | sand waves | 2 pipelines (partly buried), a cable, containers, anchors + chain, supply-vessel wreck |
| AND | Andaman, Ross Island | 27–33 m | AUV 900 kHz, 40 m (INS) | coral reef, rock, gravel | WWII aircraft wreck, 40 m wreck, ordnance, concrete reef modules, fish |
| GOA | Mormugao harbour & beach (SAR) | 5–10 m | hull-mounted 455 kHz CHIRP, 30 m | sand/mud, ripples | 4 human bodies, tyres, crab pots, fishing-boat wreck (surface returns) |
| MAN | Gulf of Mannar rocky reef | 12–17 m | towed 600 kHz, 50 m | rock outcrops, boulders, reef | **natural only**: every detection is a false positive |

Adjacent lines overlap, so most objects appear in 1–3 files, from different sides and ranges.

## What each XTF contains
* **File header**: sonar name, NavUnits = 3 (lat/lon), WGS84, 2 or 4 channel descriptors (port/starboard × low/high frequency:
  frequency, horizontal/vertical beam, tilt, uint16 samples), navigation/MRU offsets.
* **Notes packet**: line id, area, course, sonar description, "SYNTHETIC".
* **Per ping**: towfish lat/lon (after layback), ship GPS lat/lon, heading, ship gyro, speed (kn), **towfish depth**,
  **altitude** (water depth = depth + altitude), tide, pitch/roll/heave/yaw, cable out, layback, cable tension, range/bearing
  to fish, KP, water temperature, conductivity, pressure, sound speed (`SoundVelocity` = c/2, the usual one-way
  convention; `ComputedSoundVelocity` = c, from the Mackenzie equation), fix/computer clock, event number.
* **Per channel**: slant range, ground range, time duration, seconds per ping, frequency, bandwidth, gain code.
* **Attitude packet (MRU)** for every ping and a **raw GPS packet** every second.

## Physics & artefacts simulated
Slant-range geometry, water column and first return, vertical beam pattern (tilt, roll-dependent), two-way spreading and
frequency-dependent absorption with imperfect TVG, Lambert-like backscatter with local incidence, **acoustic shadows by ray
casting**, Rayleigh speckle, along-track beam smearing (wider at low frequency / far range), operator altitude control
(10–20 % of range), towfish layback with GPS and layback-estimate error (recorded ≠ true position; AUV INS drift), crab angle,
yaw/pitch/roll, heave, tide, surface returns, fish schools in the water column, operator gain changes, interference bursts,
ping dropouts. Seabed: mud / sand / gravel backscatter, ripples, sand waves, rock outcrops, coral reef, trawl scars, pockmarks.
Not simulated: multipath ghosts, variable sound-speed refraction, sediment volume scattering, vessel wake.

## Files
* `<AREA>/<LINE>.xtf`: the log (≤ 9.5 MB each, under Cloudinary's 10 MB free limit)
* `<AREA>/<LINE>_labels.json`: every object this line images: class (detector taxonomy), kind (e.g. `ghost_net`, `crab_pot`,
  `manta_mine`), **true lat/lon**, water depth, size, side, ground range, ping/sample extent, and **pixel box in the waterfall
  exactly as the AI service reads the file**; plus survey metadata, conditions and dropouts
* `<AREA>/<LINE>_labels.txt`: same boxes in YOLO format (`class cx cy w h`), classes
  `0 shipwreck, 1 aircraft_wreck, 2 mine_like_object, 3 debris, 4 human_body, 5 marine_life`
* `<AREA>/<LINE>_nav.csv`: recorded navigation at 2 Hz
* `<AREA>/area_groundtruth.json`: all objects of the area and which lines image them
* `manifest.csv`: one row per file (sonar, times, start/end position, depths, altitude, layback, sound speed, conditions, label counts)
* `previews/`, `contact_sheet.jpg`: quick looks
* `evaluation.json`: latest AI evaluation (`ai/tools/evaluate_synthetic.py`)

The detector has no "net" class, so ghost nets and crab pots are labelled `debris`; `kind` keeps the exact type.

## Current AI results (14 files, 2 per area)
| Class | Targets | Found | Right class |
|---|---|---|---|
| shipwreck | 4 | 3 | 3 |
| debris | 36 | 9 | 1 |
| mine_like_object | 15 | 1 | 1 |
| human_body | 1 | 0 | 0 |

46 false positives (36 called *shipwreck*; 9 on natural rock, the rest on seabed texture). Geotag error of matches:
median 2.6 m, p90 11 m (includes the simulated layback / GPS error).

## Regenerate / evaluate (from `ai/`)
```bash
.venv/Scripts/python tools/generate_xtf.py            # all 56 files, ~3 min with 4 workers
.venv/Scripts/python tools/generate_xtf.py --areas KOC,GOA
.venv/Scripts/python tools/evaluate_synthetic.py --per-area 2
```
